reciprocal-trig.def: The secant, cosecant and cotangent functions: $\sec x = \frac{1}{\cos x}$, $\csc x = \frac{1}{\sin x}$ and $\cot x = \frac{\cos x}{\sin x}$. Each has vertical asymptotes where its denominator is $0$. Secant and cosecant have range $(-\infty, -1] \cup [1, \infty)$ and period $2\pi$; cotangent has range $(-\infty, \infty)$ and period $\pi$.
